summary: Frontend-only test of the new JMAtv LIVE channel. All 7 requested scenarios PASSED: audio-unlock + name-prompt dismissed; LIVE banner (data-testid='jmatv-live-banner') visible on #/jmatv and routes to #/jmatv/live; the live page (jmatv-live-page) renders with pulsing badge, now-playing title, Up Next line, and a Vimeo iframe inside the CRT frame; idle 5s shows NO self-advance (stable); 'Next Show' manual advance works and cycles distinct titles; homepage CRT (home-card-jmatv) opens #/jmatv/live; back-button returns to #/jmatv. No crashes, no runaway navigation, no infinite-loop. Expected Vimeo 401 errors in sandbox (environment artifact, not a bug) were seen as noted in the brief.

issues: Element has data-testid on an inner <button> whose client bounding rect is 0x0 (display:block but width/height=0). Native .click() still fires handler and navigation works, but Playwright/user-facing hit-testing on the button itself is unreliable. Users click the surrounding CRT illustration which likely wraps this hidden button. Recommend attaching data-testid to the visible CRT wrapper, or giving the button non-zero dimensions, so automated tests and screen-reader focus rings behave normally.

test_evidence.idle_stability_5s: title stayed 'Dough is in Pizza' before and after 5s wait with no clicks (no self-advance storm)
test_evidence.upnext_sample: Faster as We Go · OFFICIAL MUSIC VIDEOS
test_evidence.vimeo_401: Observed as expected (sandbox referrer not whitelisted). Not treated as bug per request.

console_warnings_noted: React duplicate key warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' — likely in the live playlist render; worth investigating in jmatv.js / JMAtvLivePage.js. Not blocking.
AnimatePresence mode='wait' with multiple children warning.
Cloudflare Turnstile 'already rendered' warning (likely from For-Grown-Ups auth; unrelated to this feature).
action_items: Move data-testid='home-card-jmatv' onto the visible CRT wrapper element (currently on an inner button with 0x0 bounding rect). Interaction still works but automated hit-testing and focus outlines are unreliable.
Investigate the React 'duplicate key' console error on the live page — buildLivePlaylist() may emit duplicate ids when the same source item appears in more than one channel feed.
critical_code_review_comments: JMAtvLivePage advance() uses setIndex((i)=>(i+1)%len) — safe and does NOT auto-advance on error (only on 'ended'), confirmed by 5s idle stability test.

Route '/jmatv/live' is registered BEFORE '/jmatv/:channelId' in App.js, confirmed working (direct nav, banner nav, and home-card nav all resolved to the Live page, not to a channel page with id='live').
data-testid attribute present on home-card-jmatv is on a zero-dimension inner button — a11y/testability smell.
seed_data_creation: None. Set localStorage flag jma_player_name_skipped_v1=1 to skip name prompt during test runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: JMAtv LIVE feature fully functional end-to-end. HashRouter routes #/jmatv, #/jmatv/live and #/home all working. Known cosmetic/testability issue: home-card-jmatv data-testid sits on a 0x0 inner button — Playwright must use JS .click() or force=True on an outer locator; this is not a user-facing bug but should be cleaned up.
